title: ID0463011-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P5 170000502] Session doesn't stop
description:
Reported behavior/issue-
Solution: Update to v8.1.4
So the session starts even though we say "out of order"
StopTransaction is sent but not processed correctly
Charging kept going
Available sent to backend while charging
